passage:
A health app gave users badges for walking certain numbers of steps. Emma loved collecting them.
At first, the badges helped her move more. But later she became upset on days when she could not reach the goal because of heavy rain or homework.
Her brother reminded her that health was not a game score.
Emma changed the app settings and added rest days. She still walked often, but she stopped letting the badge decide her mood.
The app had encouraged a good habit, but it needed balance.
Measurements can motivate people, but they should not replace listening to the body. A number is information, not identity.
